feeds.title: World Kidney Day Blog
feeds.description: World Kidney Day is a global campaign aimed at raising awareness of the importance of our kidneys. World Kidney Day aims to raise awareness of the importance of our kidneys. The blog consists of ways to reduce the frequency and impact of kidney disease, transplant stories and much more.

feeds.title: Renal Support Network Blog
feeds.description: Lori Hartwell founded Renal Support Network (RSN) in 1993 to empower people who have kidney disease to become knowledgeable about their illness. The Chronically Happy Blog features personal stories and first-hand experiences of people living with chronic kidney disease and their families.

feeds.title: National Kidney Federation Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1979, the National Kidney Federation are the largest kidney patient charity in the UK. Run by kidney patients, for kidney patients. Here you can read stories of others living with kidney conditions.

feeds.title: Commonwealth Nephrology Associates Blog
feeds.description: Commonwealth Nephrology Associates is devoted to caring for patients with kidney diseases and associated conditions such as hypertension, kidney stones, and electrolyte disorders. We blog about the latest information regarding research and advancements in Nephrology & share news about Commonwealth Nephrology Associates in the community.

feeds.title: AJKD Blog
feeds.description: Official Blog of the American Journal of Kidney Diseases (AJKD). AJKD is recognized worldwide as a leading source of information devoted to clinical nephrology practice & clinical research. AJKD Blog provides the nephrology community with timely, engaging updates on the journal's practice-changing content, & educational material.

feeds.title: Plant-Powered Kidneys Blog
feeds.description: At Plant-Powered Kidneys, we are focused on spreading the word about evidence-based nutrition information for those with chronic kidney disease. We are a team of renal dietitian nutritionists that provide support, positivity, and motivation. Jen is the renal dietitian behind Plant-Powered Kidneys, who now focuses on sharing kidney-friendly information.

feeds.title: Kidney Research UK Blog
feeds.description: Kidney Research UK is the largest UK charity dedicated to research into the prevention, treatment and management of kidney disease. They're making important scientific breakthroughs all the time and medical researchers are constantly developing improvements in treatments. The blogs inform people about events, marathons, articles and more.

feeds.title: Texas Kidney Institute Blog
feeds.description: The Texas Kidney Institute consists of doctors with advanced training in the field of chronic kidney disease, untreated hypertension, post-kidney transplant care, diabetes-related kidney problems, anaemia and dialysis care. Read articles from Texas Kidney Institute, a leading Texas nephrology healthcare organization. Tips for living with CKD and more.

feeds.title: Kidney Cancer Association Blog
feeds.description: The Kidney Cancer Association founded by Eugene P. Schonfeld and a group of patients and doctors in Illinois is a non-profit organization. Their mission is to be a global community dedicated to serving and empowering patients and caregivers, and leading change through advocacy, research, and education.

feeds.title: Eat Away Kidney Stones
feeds.description: Registered Dietitian and kidney stone specialist, Melanie Betz MS, RD, CSR, FNKF, FAND shares science-based ways to prevent kidney stones with food!

feeds.title: International Society of Nephrology News
feeds.description: The International Society of Nephrology is a global professional association dedicated to advancing kidney health, through education, grants, research, and advocacy. Observe the latest news of ISN on their blog.

feeds.title: AAKP Blog
feeds.description: AAKP strives for change by promoting the importance of kidney health for patients across the country, by educating, advocating, and defining. This blog will allow you to connect with experts, researchers, staff and volunteers.

feeds.title: Kidney Foundation of WNY Blog
feeds.description: The Kidney Foundation of WNY works to raise community awareness of kidney disease, increase knowledge of risk factors, and provide information on prevention and treatment. Read press releases, informational items and blog posts from the Kidney Foundation of WNY (Western New York).

feeds.title: Nephrology Associates of Greater Cincinnati Blog
feeds.description: At Nephrology Associates of Greater Cincinnati, we listen and ask before creating a personalized treatment plan tailored to the individual needs of a patient. We have dedicated kidney doctors and staff whose focus on providing the best care. We provide the best care for Chronic Kidney Disease, Kidney stones, Renal Hypertension & Kidney Transplants.

feeds.title: California Kidney Specialists Blog
feeds.description: California Kidney Specialists has a team of experienced nephrologists, kidney transplant specialists and kidney transplant surgeons in California, who are dedicated to providing their patients with excellent and compassionate care and helping them lead healthy lives. Tips, guides, and much more added knowledge can be found here.

feeds.title: Healthy Kidney Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Healthy Kidney Nutrition is here to help those with kidney disease choose the best foods to improve their kidney function by providing you with delicious kidney-friendly recipes. Guides, tips, foods and much more on how to keep healthy with nutrition for those affected with kidney diseases.

feeds.title: Empowered Kidney Care Blog
feeds.description: Empowered Kidney Care exists to improve outcomes and quality of experience throughout the kidney care industry. We help healthcare providers create a culture of collaboration, offering control, dignity, and hope to all patients. We're here to equip patients and healthcare providers with tools and resources to create better results - and a better experience - for everyone involved.

feeds.title: Kidney Clinic of North Florida Blog
feeds.description: Kidney Clinic is located in Florida, Dr. Gaurav Tandon has a decade of experience treating all kidney-related diseases & provides high-quality and certified care. Our blog consists of pros and cons, diets, and all knowledge pertaining to Kidney Disease.
